map.输入营业收入、营业成本与营业费用，求 EBIT。: Compute earnings before interest and taxes from revenue, operating cost and operating expenses.
map.EBIT = 营收 − 营业成本 − 营业费用: EBIT = Revenue − Operating Cost − Operating Expenses
map.剔除利息与税的经营利润。: Operating profit with interest and tax removed.
map.跨企业对比经营盈利时，剔除资本结构与税负差异，只看主业造血能力。: When comparing operating profitability across companies, it removes differences in capital structure and tax burden and shows only the earning power of the core business.
map.估值时用 EV/EBIT 倍数，避免不同杠杆与税率扭曲可比性。: For valuation, the EV/EBIT multiple avoids comparability being distorted by differing leverage and tax rates.
map.，EBIT 不受融资决策与税收政策干扰。: , EBIT is free from financing decisions and tax policy.
map.某公司营业收入 1000 万元、营业成本 600 万元、营业费用 200 万元，: A company has revenue of 1,000 (10k CNY), operating cost of 600 (10k CNY) and operating expenses of 200 (10k CNY), so EBIT = 1000−600−200 = 200 (10k CNY) - operating profit before interest and tax.
map.EBIT 与净利润的关系？: How does EBIT relate to net profit?
map.EBIT=净利润+利息费用+所得税；它排除了融资方式（利息）与税务安排的影响，专: EBIT = net profit + interest expense + income tax; it removes the effect of financing choices (interest) and tax arrangements, focusing on operating profitability.
map.EBIT 和营业利润一样吗？: Is EBIT the same as operating profit?
map.口径接近但不完全相同：营业利润通常已扣公允价值变动、资产减值等，EBIT 更聚焦: The definitions are close but not identical: operating profit has usually already deducted fair-value changes, asset impairments and the like, whereas EBIT focuses on operating cash-based income and expenses; the statement presentation governs.
